chosen:
```t
t 1
gate loops
task find_Extra(a: seq, b: seq, n: int) returns (r: int)
  requires n >= 0
  requires len(a) == n + 1
  requires len(b) == n
  requires forall i in [0, n - 1) . a[i] == b[i]
  requires forall i in [0, n) . a[i] <= a[i + 1]
  requires forall i in [0, n - 1) . b[i] <= b[i + 1]
  ensures r >= 0 and r <= n
  ensures r == n or a[r] != b[r]
  ensures forall i in [0, r) . a[i] == b[i]
{
  r := 0;
  while r < n and a[r] == b[r]
    invariant r >= 0 and r <= n
    invariant forall i in [0, r) . a[i] == b[i]
    decreases n - r
  {
    r := r + 1;
  }
}
```
